item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 14/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will cover southeastern China today and tomorrow. The weather will be persistently very hot apart from a few showers over the region. Meanwhile, the tropical cyclone over the central and southern parts of the South China Sea will move in the general direction of the central to northern parts of Vietnam. Under the combined effect of the tropical cyclone and the subtropical ridge, winds will strengthen slightly and there will be more showers gradually over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek this week.

Weather: Sunny periods and one or two showers. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 34 C

PSR: Low
